name: io.github.falehsub/omada-mcp
title: TP-Link Omada SDN MCP Server
description: Read-only-first MCP server for TP-Link Omada SDN controllers (Web API v2, zero dependencies).

environmentVariables.name: OMADA_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Omada controller web UI root URL (https://<host>:8043 or http://<host>:8088)

environmentVariables.name: OMADA_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: Dedicated local controller username (Viewer for read-only, Admin for opt-in writes)

environmentVariables.name: OMADA_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Password for the local Omada controller account

environmentVariables.name: OMADA_SITE_NAME
environmentVariables.description: Optional default Omada site display name (pins site unless OMADA_ALLOW_CROSS_SITE=true)

environmentVariables.name: OMADA_SITE_ID
environmentVariables.description: Optional default Omada site hex ID (alternative to OMADA_SITE_NAME)

environmentVariables.name: OMADA_ALLOW_CROSS_SITE
environmentVariables.description: Allow per-call site overrides to target other visible sites when a default site is pinned (default false)

environmentVariables.name: OMADA_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Fail-closed read-only mode (default true; set false only with explicit OMADA_WRITE_TOOLS)

environmentVariables.name: OMADA_WRITE_TOOLS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated explicit allowlist of write tool names when OMADA_READ_ONLY=false

environmentVariables.name: OMADA_VERIFY_SSL
environmentVariables.description: Verify TLS certificate chain and hostname (default true)

environmentVariables.name: OMADA_CA_BUNDLE
environmentVariables.description: Optional path to a controller CA PEM bundle

environmentVariables.name: OMADA_SCHEMA_MODE
environmentVariables.description: tools/list descriptor mode: slim (default) or full

environmentVariables.name: OMADA_SNAPSHOT_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory for pre-write snapshots and JSONL write audit logs

environmentVariables.name: OMADA_BASE_URL
